processing: Internal lines are shared polygon edges, stored once and styled by the two owners. Mainland Chinese province membership uses the first two digits of the administrative code, including directly administered county-level units. CGAZ ADM1 identifies parents of other ADM2 units, or supplies shared edges where ADM2 is unavailable. No coastlines inferred from administrative polygons. Physical polygons tiled, land relief cropped from SR_50M.
kashmir: Four unverified upstream IND/PAK ADM1 units and their assigned internal edges are excluded from the internal map candidate.
